output.reason: [ev-b161f0981be8] says sourceRevisionHasChanged now checks whether the webhook-supplied revision matches the target revision's semver constraint instead of doing a simple equality check, and [ev-00578b61cfa7] confirms this fix was cherry-picked into this release, listed in [ev-be13d23a0cf1].
